items.title: Maurice Durand Interview, 1958-08-22
items.q: I played with Louis DuVean, see. Him and I was leading, he was leading the band, I was playing solo too.

ctx.x: And Maurice, do you remember Eddie Jackson, anything about him?

Oh yeah, I used to play in the tuxedo brass band with him. Oh yeah, he's a pretty good bass player. He gives you plenty of help. See I played with, I joined the tuxedo brass band when Celestane gave up playing. See I played with Louis DuVean, see. Him and I was leading, he was leading the band, I was playing solo too. Yeah, Eddie Jackson's a wonderful musician.
And then Jackson, he went on bass violin. He played with the Nola band. Yeah. Nola. Pete Lacoste, the trumpet player.
